body:
So I'm writing this while I just finished smoking it and I feel the most relaxed I have ever been in my life. I'm not really high or hallucinating, just relaxed, like on Vicodin relaxed but not the zombie effect it gives me.
I ordered mugwort online after hearing about it's dream effects. I drank the tea for the first time Tuesday and didn't dream so I drank some today and didn't get the relaxed feeling people talk about with the tea so I decided to smoke it.
I went into my backyard and lit up about a nug and didn't feel much instantly. The smoke is a bit harsh on the roof of my mouth/throat but tolerable if I inhale right. I lit up a few more nugs and didn't really feel the effects until after I finished smoking.
Let me tell you it is the most relaxing smoke I've had. Now I wouldn't call it a weed substitute but it can come pretty close.
